status: PRIVATE DIAGNOSTIC ONLY; not deployed; not TPS eligible
base: Published v17 9b2ced98f source (copied while v17 was pending; helper SHA e877e18f unchanged by commit)
instrumentation_gate: NNTR_MOE_IO_PROFILE=1 at begin_qs2_host_prefetch; immutable per-bank begin timestamp=0 disables new clocks
clocks: std::chrono::steady_clock microseconds, same clock as HtpProfile::nowUs

timestamps.begin_us: Entry to begin_qs2_host_prefetch before catalog validation, FD duplication and worker activation
timestamps.first_read_us: Earliest successful readOne invocation, before bank lock, payload new[] and reader callback
timestamps.last_read_us: Last completed readOne, measured under existing bank completion lock before publishing done; includes payload allocation, first-touch and callback
timestamps.read_service_us: Sum of successful readOne durations including allocation, callback, scheduling and completion-lock wait; failures still included
timestamps.first_wait_begin_us: Caller timestamp in first waitHostExpertReads before waitReads
timestamps.first_wait_end_us: First waitReads completion before releasing its existing lock
timestamps.cancel_begin_us: cancelAndWait entry before its existing bank lock
timestamps.cancel_end_us: cancelAndWait after joining active reads/leases and freeing residual payloads/FDs

derived_metrics.bank_ready_slack_ms: (first_wait_begin_us-last_read_us)/1000; positive proves bank ready before transition; negative means overlap/wait

limitations: The bank-ready slack is a scheduling opportunity, not proof every reader thread stayed idle throughout it.
read_service_us is concurrent aggregate duration and cannot be directly subtracted from model wall time.
No unstarted/cancelled read has a readOne timestamp; zero fields mean unobserved, not time zero.
Allocation/free and production work remain in the same scopes; this changes instrumentation only.
